substantive_decision.lock_ownership: storage.py __exit__ uses fstat(fd) then lstat(lock_path) then unlink(lock_path). Existing replacement-before-lstat regression passes under bounded executor; a replacement between lstat and unlink can still remove the replacement pathname. This is a source-derived operator-recovery interleaving, not a demonstrated ordinary concurrent-writer or production failure.
no_network_test_contract: On exact current SHA in tmp_path, use the existing test_archive_concurrent_dedup.py fixture as baseline. Confirm ordinary acquire/release/reacquire and replacement-before-lstat sentinel preservation as positive controls; keep child crash exitcode=17, preexisting orphan timeout, PID-write ENOSPC cleanup.

Create an original ArchiveWriterLock in a test-owned tmp_path. Patch Path.lstat with a one-shot wrapper only for its lock_path: call original_lstat first to capture original inode/dev; before returning that old stat, os.replace(original lock_path, backup_path), then create a distinct replacement lock via O_CREAT|O_EXCL, write sentinel, and record replacement inode/dev. Restore the patch immediately after __exit__.

Assert replacement lock still exists with same sentinel and inode/dev. Current source predicts FAIL (unlink uses stale lstat result); label as simulated manual-recovery TOCTOU, not normal writer failure. Always release/cleanup test-owned backup and replacement paths in finally. No external network, no sleeps as synchronization oracle.
